name: ALF transcription elongation factor 1

function.text: AFF1 encodes AF4/FMR2 family member 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and transcription elongation factor activity. It participates in DNA-templated transcription elongation and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: AFF1 is a recurrent fusion partner of KMT2A in acute lymphoblastic leukemia. The fusion context should be distinguished from an isolated AFF1 sequence variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Gene-specific alteration context described by NCBI/RefSeq; variant applicability requires review.
